svg.title: Time to properly verify one full 128 GB card at 250 MB/s
svg.desc: Two horizontal bars. Checking it yourself by hand in Finder and Terminal: copy, then read both the card and the copy to compare checksums, three full passes, about 25 minutes. MediaFlowSwift's import: copy while taking the card's checksum, then read the copy back once, two full passes, about 17 minutes. Both figures are arithmetic from the card's size and transfer speed, not a benchmark; the real figure depends on the card, the reader and the drive.
svg.text: One full 128 GB card, copied and checked at 250 MB/s
Arithmetic from card size and transfer speed, not a benchmark — the real figure depends on the card, reader and drive.
